content: Pdu Gateway support The IPduMapping arranges those IPdu s that are transferred by the Gateway from one PhysicalChannel to the other (or the same) PhysicalChannel in pairs and defines the mapping between them. Each pair consist of a sourceIPdu and a targetIPdu referencing to a PduTrig- gering .
